What Is ezyVet?

ezyVet is a cloud-based veterinary practice management solution that has served the veterinary industry since 2006. Originally built in Auckland, New Zealand (now part of IDEXX), ezyVet is now part of the IDEXX family, giving it unparalleled access to diagnostic lab integrations. With 15,000+ clinics worldwide, ezyVet is one of the most widely deployed cloud PIMS solutions on the market today.

We found ezyVet to be the most customizable cloud-based PIMS we have tested. The platform supports small animal, large animal, specialty, emergency, multi-location practice types, making it one of the few systems that can genuinely handle everything from a single-doctor small animal clinic to a multi-location specialty and emergency hospital group. Its advanced workflow engine allows practices to tailor nearly every aspect of the system to their specific processes.

Pricing for ezyVet starts at approximately $250/mo with a custom quote based on practice size approach. The investment is justified for larger operations that need deep customization and robust reporting, though smaller practices may find it more than they need.

Key Features

We evaluated every major feature of ezyVet. Here is a breakdown of what the platform offers.

Comprehensive EMR

A full electronic medical records system with customizable templates, SOAP notes, and treatment tracking across all departments.

Advanced reporting

One of the most powerful reporting suites in the industry, covering financial, clinical, and operational metrics with custom report builders.

Inventory management

End-to-end inventory tracking with automated reordering, supplier management, and controlled substance logs.

Client portal

A self-service portal where pet owners can view appointment history, access records, and make payments.

IDEXX integration

As an IDEXX-owned product, ezyVet offers the deepest diagnostic lab integration available in any cloud PIMS.

Automated communications

Scheduled reminders, appointment confirmations, and follow-up messages sent automatically via email and SMS.

Financial reporting

Detailed financial dashboards including revenue tracking, accounts receivable, and profitability analysis by service type.

Custom workflows

Build practice-specific workflows for admissions, discharges, referrals, and any other multi-step clinical process.

Our Value Assessment

At $250/mo, ezyVet is positioned at the premium end of the market. The higher price point reflects the depth of features available, but practices should ensure they need that level of functionality before committing.

Who Is ezyVet Best For?

Based on our testing, ezyVet is the strongest fit for the following practice types.

1

Large hospitals

ezyVet scales to handle high patient volumes, complex scheduling, and the reporting demands of larger hospital operations.

2

Specialty/referral clinics

ezyVet's advanced clinical tools and customizable workflows are designed to handle the complexity that specialty and teaching environments demand.

3

Multi-location enterprises

ezyVet handles the complexity of managing multiple clinic locations from a single platform, with consolidated reporting and centralized data.

Who Should Look Elsewhere?

No software is perfect for every practice. Here are situations where ezyVet may not be the best fit.

  • Small or start-up practices looking for a simple, easy-to-learn system should consider alternatives like Shepherd or Hippo Manager. ezyVet's steep learning curve and complex onboarding process can overwhelm smaller teams.
  • Budget-conscious solo veterinarians will find ezyVet's pricing significantly above entry-level options. The custom quote model means costs can escalate quickly for larger practices.
  • Clinics that want a plug-and-play solution without extensive configuration time should look elsewhere. ezyVet's strength is its customizability, but that comes at the cost of a longer setup and training period.

Final Verdict

ezyVet is our recommendation for large hospitals, specialty clinics, and multi-location enterprises that need a powerful, customizable cloud PIMS backed by IDEXX's diagnostic ecosystem. The learning curve is real, but practices that invest the time in configuration end up with a system that fits their workflow precisely. At approximately $250/mo, it is a serious investment best suited for practices with serious operational needs.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is ezyVet cloud-based?
Yes. ezyVet is a cloud-based platform. You can access it from any device with a web browser and an internet connection. There is no server hardware to purchase or maintain.
Does ezyVet offer a free trial?
Yes, ezyVet offers a free trial so you can test the platform before committing. We recommend using the trial period to evaluate the features most important to your practice, such as scheduling, medical records, and any integrations you rely on.
What is ezyVet's starting price?
ezyVet starts at $250 per month. The pricing model is custom quote based on practice size, so your actual cost may vary depending on your practice size and configuration. Contact ezyVet directly for an exact quote tailored to your needs.
Is ezyVet good for small practices?
ezyVet can work for small practices, but it is primarily designed for large hospitals. Smaller practices may find that they are paying for features they do not need. We recommend evaluating alternatives like Shepherd ($99/mo) or Hippo Manager ($120/mo) if you run a small or solo practice.
